title: Spiced cauliflower soup with crispy lamb

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Lamb mince, vegetables, stock, spices and Greek yoghurt are all ordinary kitchen staples.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is an everyday item at any mainstream supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: Only one large pan and a stick blender for soup are needed, and the techniques are simple.

works.reason: A large cauliflower and a potato in 1.2 litres of stock make a sensible soup for four. The 250g of crisped spiced lamb is a fair topping, though 'the rest of the cumin' gives no total, so most cooks would simply add another teaspoon.

honest_times.reason: Chopping four vegetables plus 13 minutes of frying fits roughly within 20 minutes of prep, and the 20-minute simmer matches the cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warming blended cauliflower soup suits a cold November lunch, and the cauliflower is clearly the point of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, plain British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a vegetable-rich soup with a protein topping that a family would happily eat.
